若 m > 1，則下列何者為等比數列？
I. 2^m, 2^{2m}, 2^{3m}, 2^{4m}
II. m, 2m^2, 3m^4, 4m^8
III. log m, log m^2, log m^4, log m^8

A. 只有 I 及 II
B. 只有 I 及 III
C. 只有 II 及 III
D. I、II 及 III
reasoning: Sequence I is geometric with constant ratio 2^m. Sequence III simplifies to log m, 2 log m, 4 log m, 8 log m, which also has a constant ratio of 2, so it is geometric. Sequence II does not have a constant ratio for arbitrary m>1, so it is not geometric. Therefore only I and III are geometric, which corresponds to option B.
